title: Osc2-CTX-FLoad-LN (k=320,p=34,H=96,a_max=0.993) + scale-invariant U/V orthonormal + γ prior
abstract: LN base with p=34 and Adam. Compute orthonormal penalties on column-normalized U,V (scale-invariant) plus a tiny γ schedule prior to reduce seed variance. Keep MAE+curvature and residual copy.
